name: A payment inside the grace period carries no late fee
title: SC-07-10-05 A payment inside the grace period carries no late fee
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the site's grace period is 5 days
And unit "A-14" owes 1400.00 due on "2026-10-15"
When 1400.00 is received for unit "A-14" on "2026-10-19"
Then the liability is paid with a late fee of 0.00
